name: pi Assistant

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created, edited] # edited: a box ticked on one of pi's questions
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

# The job acts with a GitHub App token (the pi-action-agent App), not GITHUB_TOKEN. GITHUB_TOKEN can't open
# pull requests here, and what it pushes doesn't trigger workflows, so pi's branches would get no CI.
permissions: {}

jobs:
  pi-response:
    # @pi requests, /answer replies, and edits of pi's questions (not other edited comments). Never events
    # from a bot: with an App token, pi's own comments and edits would otherwise start new runs.
    if: >-
      github.event.sender.type != 'Bot'
      && ((github.event.action == 'edited' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '<!-- pi-action:question'))
      || (github.event.action != 'edited' && (contains(github.event.comment.body || github.event.issue.body || github.event.pull_request.body || '', '@pi')
      || contains(github.event.comment.body || '', '/answer'))))
    # Job-level, so runs the `if` skips never take the thread's single pending slot from a real one.
    concurrency:
      group: pi-action-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45

    steps:
      - name: Mint a GitHub App token
        id: app
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.PI_APP_CLIENT_ID }} # a secret, not a variable: the npm actionlint (1.6.x) predates `vars`
          private-key: ${{ secrets.PI_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          permission-contents: write
          permission-issues: write
          permission-pull-requests: write
          permission-discussions: write
          permission-actions: read
          permission-checks: read
          permission-statuses: read
          permission-workflows: write

      - name: Commit as the App's bot user
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          SLUG: ${{ steps.app.outputs.app-slug }}
        run: |
          id=$(gh api "/users/${SLUG}%5Bbot%5D" --jq .id)
          {
            echo "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=${SLUG}[bot]"
            echo "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=${SLUG}[bot]"
            echo "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=${id}+${SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            echo "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=${id}+${SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }} # pushes (branches, tags, refs/pi/threads/*) as the App
          fetch-depth: 0 # tags and history, for release notes and version bumps

      - name: Run pi-action
        uses: ./  # Dogfooding: the action from this checkout (main for comments)
        with:
          github_token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          provider: nvidia
          model: aws/anthropic/bedrock-claude-opus-5-5
          api_key: ${{ secrets.NVIDIA_API_KEY }}
          provider_base_url: https://inference-api.nvidia.com
          provider_api: anthropic-messages
          model_name: Opus 5.5
          model_reasoning: true
          model_input: text,image
          model_context_window: 1050000
          model_max_tokens: 128000 # Bedrock's maximum for Opus 5.5
          compat_force_adaptive_thinking: true
          extensions: github:cv/pit#v0.35.1
